name: Lumax Auto Technologies Ltd
tagline: High-quality, JV-rich auto-ancillary compounder -- 34% FY26 revenue growth, 26% ROE, Rs 1,450 Cr order book, CRISIL upgrade -- but at ~Rs 13,000 Cr and mid-20s% guided growth it is a compounder, not a 10x/100x candidate
business_overview: Lumax Auto Technologies (LATL) supplies advanced plastics (cockpits, consoles, door panels, air-intake, tanks), structures & control systems (gear shifters, actuators, seating structures), mechatronics (power-window switches, telematics/TCUs, O2 sensors), aftermarket parts and alternate-fuel/CNG-hydrogen systems. It runs a large stable of JVs (IAC India, Mannoh, Alps Alpine, Yokowo, Greenfuel). Key customers: Mahindra (~27%), Bajaj Auto (~14%), Maruti, Honda 2W, Tata Motors.
fundamentals_table: Revenue ~Rs 4,870 Cr (+34% YoY); EBITDA ~Rs 705 Cr (~14.5% margin); PAT ~Rs 337 Cr (+47% YoY)
~Rs 1,450 Cr, ~90% new business, ~40% EV-agnostic/clean-mobility; realisation weighted to FY27-FY28
~25% FY26 growth; EBITDA margin 14-15%, targeting ~16% by FY27; organic growth ~1.5x industry
D/E ~0.46; long-term debt ~Rs 553 Cr; CRISIL upgrade AA- -> AA; free cash ~Rs 396 Cr
fundamentals_narrative: A genuinely well-run compounder: 34% FY26 revenue growth, high-teens/low-20s ROCE, mid-20s ROE, a rating upgrade, a visible multi-year order book skewed to margin-accretive mechatronics (24% of the order book vs ~6% of revenue), and a credible content-per-vehicle plus new-JV growth model. Management's own framing is ~20-25% organic growth with margins drifting toward 16% -- solid, but nowhere near the growth slope a 10x-in-2-3-years or 100x-in-10-years outcome would require from a ~Rs 13,000 Cr base.
technical_read: Not pulled -- stock roughly doubled off its 2025 low; trades toward the upper half of its 52-week range.
sentiment_summary: Read the most recent 50 posts (#17-67), spanning 2013 to Aug 2026 with a dense 2024-2026 block. Sentiment is consistently positive on business quality: members repeatedly call it 'a true compounder' at 'reasonable valuations for a good auto OEM'. ranvir (trusted, elevated-tier) posts detailed quarterly concall notes every quarter -- uniformly constructive but framed as tracking updates, not a fresh high-conviction buy call. Recurring caveats raised on-thread: heavy Mahindra concentration (~27%), a high dividend payout despite debt, and a 2019 minority-unfriendly transfer of the PCB unit to group company Lumax Industries; related-party transactions have historically been ~20% of turnover.
community_signal: No explicit roster high-conviction call. ranvir (trusted, elevated-tier) provides ongoing positive quarterly concall coverage -- informational rather than a buy call.

trusted_signals.username: ranvir / GurpreetSingh (trusted-tier concall notes on thread)
trusted_signals.note: Q3 FY26: revenue +40% YoY, EBITDA +51% (15% margin), PBT +56%; order book Rs 1,450 Cr with mechatronics 24% of it (margin-accretive). Constructive tracking update, not a fresh conviction call.

bse_notes: Historical: 2019 sale of the PCB unit to Lumax Industries at ~1x EBITDA flagged by members as a possible value transfer. Related-party transactions historically ~20% of turnover. Corporate guarantees / Section 186 limit enhancements for the IAC JV. No active regulatory action noted.
bull_case: High-quality compounder: ~34% FY26 revenue growth, ~21% ROCE, ~26% ROE, CRISIL upgrade to AA
Rs 1,450 Cr order book, ~90% new business, weighted to FY27-FY28 and to margin-accretive mechatronics
EV-agnostic portfolio (>90% of revenue), content-per-vehicle expansion, and a deep JV bench (IAC, Alps Alpine, Greenfuel CNG/hydrogen)
Management executing well on margin (targeting ~16% EBITDA by FY27) with a manageable balance sheet
bear_case: At ~Rs 13,000 Cr with ~20-25% guided growth, the 10x-in-2-3-years / 100x-in-10-years bar is mathematically out of reach
Customer concentration -- Mahindra ~27% -- and cyclicality of the underlying auto build
Governance history: 2019 PCB-unit transfer to Lumax Industries seen as minority-unfriendly; related-party transactions ~20% of turnover
Stock has already doubled off its low; valuation now prices in the growth
verdict_headline: Excellent auto-ancillary compounder, wrong size/slope for this screen's 10x/100x thesis
verdict_reasoning: thesis_fit neither: a ~Rs 13,000 Cr company guiding ~20-25% organic growth cannot 10x in 2-3 years or sustain the ~58% CAGR a 100x-in-10-years outcome needs, and no catalyst on the thread bridges that gap
Business quality, order book and management execution are all genuinely good -- this is a filter-out on return-slope/size, not on quality or red flags
First-time deep read; no red-flag tier; trusted coverage (ranvir) is positive but informational, so no conviction floor applies
Conviction Low (as a thesis idea). revisit_after_30d false -- it would only re-enter if a step-change catalyst (a transformational order or acquisition materially altering the growth rate) emerged.

four_box.note: Verdict explicit: 'business quality, order book and management execution are all genuinely good' guiding ~20-25% organic growth (tailwind=yes); but 'cannot 10x in 2-3 years or sustain the ~58% CAGR a 100x-in-10-years outcome needs' (tam=no) - a pure return-slope/size filter-out.
